title: Scandinavian Mighty Ones
wikitext:
Scandinavian Mighty Ones was a duel tournament started up and maintained by [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Sammael]] of [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Black Lords of Inefficiency]] and hosted by FragZone. It began in 1997, and closed about one year later. SMO worked as a ladder with an [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elo_rating_system ELO-based] ranking system, so the skill differense between the players would determine the ladder points won and lost after the match. A top player winning over a bottom player would hardly effect the ratings, the reverse result would give a huge boost to the poorly rated player and vice versa.

When Sammael shut down SMO, [http://web.archive.org/web/19980117193508/http://www.fragzone.se/smo/ he put out a hall of fame], shown below, titled: «These are the people who have ruled the SMO through history.»
